Name: Echo Reef
Author: MrMrRogers
Description:
[b]The inital story of this mod is now playable! Travel to Echo Reef and build connections with the locals to help them thrive.

[/b]This is an expansion mod that adds a whole new world with multiple districts, a bunch of new NPCs, and a storyline to follow as well. Echo Reef exists mostly separately from the rest of the game so should be compatible with most other mods. 

The shops in each district will be closed on different days:
Mondays: Graveyard
Tuesdays: Town
Wednesdays: Fields
Thursdays: Forest
Fridays: Beach
Saturdays: Mines

On Sundays all shops are closed, but a market is set up in the town square where various shopkeeps will sell their goods depending on the week.

NOTES:

Thank you so much to LavenderSkelly for their[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14916] Dwarf Portrait Replacement[/url] mod, which I used for Izzy's portrait.

While the story of this mod is technically now playable, it revolved around building connections with different villagers throughout Echo Reef. While you can do this and 'complete' the main goal of the mod, there are currently no heart events for the NPCs, so the story is likely to feel a bit empty. This is the next step for me to work on.

I am aware of some pathing issues with the NPCs (I've noticed it with Beckett, Chan, and Meena, but I'm sure there are others as well). I am currently looking into it, but let me know if you encounter issues as it may help me locate the problem.

Echo Reef is a large mod, with the opton to add over 50 new characters, each with their own events, stories, and often with goods to sell. Some characters will always be present, but most of the characters can be toggled on or off through the config menu so that not all of them need to be loaded into the game at once. This should hopefully make it possible to play without loading issues, and also mean that you do not have to include every character if they do not all interest you. By default, all the optional characters have been toggled on, but they can all be toggled off through the config menu.

One character from each district is always present. The default characters are: Matt, Jem, Balthazar, Elodie, Mae, Foster, and Kane.

HOW TO ACCESS:

Echo Reef can be accessed through the south-east beach at Ginger Island. You can walk into the water, swim to the bottom of the map, and you will arrive in a small stretch of water. Swim to the left and up, and then swim further up on the next map and into the cave entrance. Once there, climb out of the water and click on the boat to access the main world of Echo Reef. ﻿The entrance has been set to be always accessible, but conditions for unlock can be toggled on in the config menu. Entrance points can also be set on the beach and in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19654]Richie's[/url] farmland if you have my other mod. Simply toggle the option in the config menu on and then click the crystal in the appropriate area to warp to and from Echo Reef.
